newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grains slow amid futures price fall.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grains slow amid futures price fall.

text.p: A fall in futures prices frightened the sellers away in a UK cash grains markets which was already stuck firmly in a post holiday lull, traders said.
"It's a fairly dull day. The futures drop kept sellers out of the market," one trader said.
Brokers reported feed wheat traded for delivery to East Anglia in April at 102.50 stg to 103.50 stg, with May at 105.00 stg and June at 106.00 stg.
Milling wheat was traded for delivery to Avonmouth in April at 113.00 stg.
Barley traded for delivery to Southampton in April at 102.00 stg and 101.50 stg.
